name: list_printers
summary: List the printers on this Mac, each one's state (idle / printing / disabled), and which is the system default. A disabled printer is the usual cause of jobs not coming out — use open_settings (pane 'printers') to re-enable or reconnect it.

name: list_print_jobs
summary: List print jobs currently queued across all printers (job id, owner, size). An empty queue is reported plainly.

name: print_file
summary: Send a file to a printer. STAGED; printing consumes paper/ink and cannot be undone. Defaults to the system default printer unless 'printer' is given.

params.name: file
params.description: Path to the file to print (leading ~ ok). PDF, text, and image files print directly; other types depend on installed filters.

params.name: printer
params.description: Printer to use (from list_printers). Omit for the system default.

name: print_test_page
summary: Print a short built-in test page to confirm a printer works. STAGED; consumes paper/ink and cannot be undone. Defaults to the system default printer unless 'printer' is given.

params.name: printer
params.description: Printer to test (from list_printers). Omit for the system default.
